_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic strip panel, black brush-pen ink line with muddy early-2000s digital flat colors, rubbery kinetic linework, mid-2000s webcomic look, limited palette, slightly misregistered fills. a reference swatch sheet for a mid-2000s webcomic: samples of rubbery brush-pen line, muddy slightly misregistered digital flat colors, a saturated CRT-glow lighting sample, an over-wet watercolor sky that bled past its ink beside a controlled one, rust bleeding orange into gray on corrugated tin, a small stick figure drawn at the back of a panel, a tiny gull drawn at two-thirds size beside a normal one; labeled ERA II 2004–2011. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, painterly, glossy, watermark, extra fingers
